janitor() now reads run status only from the evidence repo (its `evidence` arg, else fleet.json's setting). launch.mjs ~802 passes no evidence, so test_launch_duplicate (c)[M3] fails until launch hands janitor `evidence` and its stubs answer repos/<evidence>/contents/runs/...

factory/boot.sh now: EVIDENCE_REPO read from $FLEET_HOME/fleet-evidence-repo; evidence is a shallow clone of live/<slug>/run-<N>; record in runs/<slug>/<N>/; one tag <slug>/run-<N> cut at publish end, parked path and fail(); engine gets --past-dir $FLEET_HOME/past/<M> (highest earlier tag).

boot.sh's ENGINE_EVIDENCE list reads `snapshots.jsonlred-checks.json` (two names fused), so red-checks.json is never committed to the run folder and a --past-dir never carries it. I left it as it was (outside task 3). Whoever owns the past-run read (task 4) may want to split it.
